reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly identifying a well-known synergistic wear-corrosion mechanism (oxide film disruption leading to galvanic/pitting attack) and applying it to a plausible microstructural feature (eutectic phase boundaries) under relevant conditions.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and well-designed, with a controlled comparison of three conditions and a specific, measurable falsification criterion (absence of cyclic oxide removal and correlated damage), though the real-time, in-situ characterization at 500°C is extremely challenging.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful hypothesis that provides a concrete, mechanistic framework and a direct experimental roadmap for investigating a critical degradation mode in eutectic high-entropy alloys, directly addressing the research question.
